m: क्रैडिनीया f. scil. इष्टि, the Iṣṭi or sacrificial oblation sacred to the Maruts, KātyŚr. ii and iv, Sch.

v: tri॰ krIqI marut devatA'sya aR vede ni॰ nalopABAvaH । krIqidEvatye sAkameDIye tftIyAhe prAtaHsavanike aRqadvayaSiSnarUpe havizi । “SiSnAnyevAsya krEqinaM haviH SiSnErhi krIqatIvAyamevAvAN prARaH” Sata॰ 11, 5, 2, 4 “aRqO liNgaM ceti trIRi SiSnAni” BA॰ “tftIye'hanyupAMSvantaryAmO hutvA pOrRRAdarvvaM prAtaH savanikezu krEqinam” ASva॰ SrO॰ 9 । 2 । 15 taddravyamaDikftya izwiH Ca । krEqinIyA izwiBede sA ca izwiH dyAtyA॰ SrO॰ 5, 7, 1 sUtrAdO darSitA । tasyAH padDatiSca saMkzepeRa karkaBAzye darSitA yaTA “aTa krEqinIyA dvihavizkezwirucyate tatra marudByaH krIqimyaH saptakapAlaH, adityE caruH, ime havizI samAnatantre BavataH pratIzwyudDaraRapakze krEqinyAdityezwyarTamizwyadDaraRe krEqinyAdityezwiByAmahaM yakzye iti । varaRe zAtrAsAdane saptakapAlAni ekA carusTAlI, dakziRA anvAhAryaH SatAvadAnAnantaram, mekzaRam viMSatiriDmakAzWAni puroqASapAtryekA anyatsarvaM prakftivat । grahaRe marudByaH krIqiByo juzwam, adityE juzwam । prokzaRe marudByaH krIqiByastvA juzwam adityE tvA juzwam । nAnAvIjapakze taddBarmA uktAH ekavIjapakze karaRAnte viBajyAlamBaH idaM marutA krIqinAm; idamadityAH । prARadAne marutaH krIqino gacCa, adi tiM gacCa, saptadaSena vajreRetyavabADane । uttamaprayAje idamagnaye somAya marunnyaH krIqiByo'dityE deveBya ityAdi । praDAnayAge marudByaH krIqiByo'nubrUhi marutaH krIqino yaja idaM marudByaH krIqiByaH, adityAanuGrUhi aditiM yaja idamadityE, mekzaRena caroravadAnam । syizwakfdAdi puroqASasya prASitreqAvyatiriktaM na Bavati carostu sarvaM Bavatyeva । vyUhane marutAM krIqinAmadityA ujJitim marutaH krIqino'ditistamapanudantu । prastarahome idamagnaye somAya marudByaH krIqiByo'dityE deveBya iti । anyatkarmApavargAntaM prakftivat iti”
m: क्रैडिन mf(ई)n. (fr. क्रीडिन्), belonging to the Maruts or winds, ŚBr. xi, 5, 2, 4; ĀśvŚr. ix, 2; ŚāṅkhŚr. xiv, 10, 7; KātyŚr. ii and iv, Sch.

v: pu॰ krivIRAM paYcAlAnAM rAjA bA॰ Yya । krivideSa rAjaBede kriviSabde udA॰
m: क्रैव्य m. a king of the Krivis, ŚBr. xiii, 5, 4, 7.
